content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: missing (critical)** — Section 20 contained only a one-way Customer indemnity in Vendor's favour ("every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services"), with no Vendor indemnity at all; Section 9.3 even cross-references infringement remedies "required by Section 20.5" that do not exist in the document.

**Redline (preferred, validated):**
- Narrowed 20.1 to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.
- Added 20.2 Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct.
- Added 20.3 notice/control/cooperation procedure, 20.4 customary IP exclusions, and 20.5 procure/modify/replace/refund remedies (curing the broken 9.3 cross-reference).
- Fallback flagged in the comment: a 3× annual Fees super-cap on Vendor's indemnity.
